standard_prerequisites: Standard single-faced shuffle/pre-Lie calculus and moment–cumulant theory
core_obligations: Even granting the standard dendriform/pre-Lie exponential identities and known single-faced moment–cumulant theory, the author must construct the translucent left/right word category and compatible horizontal/vertical products, establish their exchange compatibility, split the incomplete-word coproduct at the necklace-minimal opaque letter, and identify the fixed-point iterates with shaded noncrossing, interval and monotone bipartitions. Compatibility of insertion and restriction with the two orders, plus the bijective reconstruction of the admissible bipartitions, is the substantive remaining construction. The complete author construction and its three cumulant outcomes are retained together as one H2 unit; elementary interval-map, adjunction, group and classical-series consequences are not additional problems.
